title: epikrisis — how the Eunoia ecosystem is developing
tagline: Evidence and analysis for the repositories of the Eunoia ecosystem
lede: Epikrisis reads the git histories of the **Eunoia ecosystem** — a group of repositories built around one proof calculus — and asks what actually happened: what was built, what stalled, and where a project's own account of itself differs from its tree. The commit census includes **cvc5 and ethos on main**, with counts and pins recorded so anybody with the checkouts can reproduce them.

highlight.subject: eunoia-ecosystem-s2
highlight.title: Two presidencies, in commits
highlight.blurb: One repository at a time holds the presidency and sets the direction of shared work for a stretch. **Two stretches have run.** The charts and table below count the ten member repositories together with **cvc5 and ethos on main**. Stretch 1 covers August 29 to the September 15 handoff; Stretch 2 runs from that handoff to the September 18 snapshot. Whole-history counts include all commits reachable from each repository's pin; the stretch columns count commits within those windows.
